tools.name: mcp_indian_railways_get_fare
tools.description: Retrieves fare information for a train journey between specified stations. This function queries the Indian Railways API to fetch detailed fare breakdowns for all available travel classes on the specified train route, including base fare, reservation charges, GST, and other applicable fees. Returns: JSON response containing comprehensive fare details including:, Class-wise base fares, Applicable taxes and surcharges, Dynamic/flexi fare if applicable, Concession eligibility, Super-fast charges, Reservation fees, Total fare breakdown, , If any required parameter is empty or invalid response is received, If API request fails or returns non-200 status code

tools.name: pharmacy_mcp_drug_label_warnings_mcp
tools.description: Fetches critical safety information from the official FDA drug label. This includes boxed warnings (the most serious type), contraindications (situations where the drug should not be used), and known drug interactions. This is a primary tool for assessing a drug's major safety risks before prescribing or dispensing. Returns: JSON string with boxed warnings, contraindications, and interaction data

tools.name: rss_mcp_server_get_feed

Will attempt to find RSS feed and return title, summary and link to full article for most recent n items in feed. This function is slow and resource heavy, only call it when the user wants to check a feed for new content, or asks for content from a feed that you have not retrieved yet.

tools.name: E_commerce_analyst_MCP_do_annova
tools.description: this function runs the annova on the dataset and render the associated F_score and p_value table_name is the name of the table on which you want to run the ANOVA the selected table MUST have the following signature: groups | measurement exemple with the product_type_age table: type | age ---------- 'Coat', '36' 'Coat', '36' 'Hat/beanie', '32' ... min_sample_size is used to exclude categories that does not have enough measurement. default = 0: all categories are selected return type is: dict { "F-statistic": round(f_stat, 3), "p-value": round(p_value, 3) }

tools.name: GPXRunnerTools_mcp_detect_intervals
tools.description: Detects effort and recovery intervals using pace-based z-score logic. Returns: A dictionary containing:, intervals (list): List of detected intervals (type, start, end, duration, avg pace), method (str): Detection method used, baseline_pace_min_per_km (float): Median baseline pace used, total_effort_blocks (int): Number of detected effort intervals, total_blocks (int): Total intervals (effort + recovery), expected_repetitions (int): Provided expected number, if any, match_expectation (bool): Whether the number of efforts matches the expected count

tools.name: sec_edgar_mcp_show_available_10q_by_quarters

Caveat the quarter used here is the quarter of when 10-Q is filed to SEC in calendar year system, not the company's fiscal year. Remember to use the report date to align with financial reports from other companies. Returns: A dictionary mapping company identifiers to their available financial report sheets.

tools.name: pharmacy_mcp_calculate_drug_burden_index_mcp
tools.description: Calculates the Drug Burden Index (DBI) for a patient's medication list. The DBI is a measure of a person's total exposure to anticholinergic and sedative drugs, which are associated with an increased risk of falls and cognitive impairment, especially in the elderly. This intelligent version automatically detects the route of administration for each medication (e.g., oral, transdermal patches, parenteral injections) and uses the appropriate reference data for each route, making it suitable for complex, real-world medication regimens. Returns: JSON string with DBI calculation results broken down by route and individual drug contributions

tools.description: Performs an advanced search of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database with powerful filtering options. This tool is designed for in-depth pharmacovigilance analysis, allowing users to narrow down adverse event reports by patient age, gender, and the seriousness of the event.
